description: Header file defining string splitting utilities, including functions for splitting strings by delimiters, whitespace handling, and key-value pair extraction within the 'base' namespace.

methods.name: SplitString
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on separators, whitespace handling, and result type.

methods.name: SplitStringPiece
methods.description: Splits a string into string_view tokens referencing the original buffer.

methods.name: SplitStringIntoKeyValuePairs
methods.description: Splits a string into key-value pairs based on delimiters, removing surrounding whitespace.

methods.name: SplitStringUsingSubstr
methods.description: Splits a string using a substring delimiter, with options for whitespace handling and result type.

methods.name: SplitStringPieceUsingSubstr
methods.description: Splits a string into string_view tokens using a substring delimiter.
